title: PhaseBreak: Proactive Temporal Protection against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Animation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image-to-Video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single portrait or photograph, enabling shared images to be repurposed for motion synthesis without the subject's authorization. We study proactive visual protection against such use: before an image is released, its owner applies a bounded perturbation that preserves the sharing workflow but disrupts downstream motion generation. Existing spectral disruption objectives globally attenuate temporal representations and therefore provide limited control over subtle or spatially localized motion. Our key idea is that generated dynamics depend not only on temporal feature strength, but also on the order in which feature events occur. We propose PhaseBreak, a white-box spectral retiming protection method that matches intermediate denoiser features to a constrained temporal rearrangement of their clean counterparts. translated_title: PhaseBreak：针对未经授权图像到视频动画的主动式时间保护
translated_abstract: 图像到视频（I2V）扩散模型能够让单张肖像或照片动起来，这使得共享的图像可以在未经当事人授权的情况下被重新用于运动合成。我们研究了针对此类用途的主动式视觉保护：在图像发布之前，图像所有者对其施加一个有界扰动，该扰动在保留图像分享工作流程的同时，破坏下游的运动生成。现有的频谱破坏目标会对时间表示进行全局衰减，因此对细微的或空间上局部化的运动控制能力有限。我们的核心思想是：生成的动态不仅取决于时间特征的强度，还取决于特征事件发生的顺序。我们提出PhaseBreak，一种白盒频谱重定时保护方法，它将中间去噪器特征与其干净对应特征的受约束时间重排相匹配。PhaseBreak沿真实时间轴运行，并使用主体感知的掩码（摘要至此截断）
tldr: PhaseBreak提出一种白盒频谱重定时保护方法，其核心创新在于利用“生成动态取决于特征事件发生的顺序而非仅是强度”这一洞察，通过有界扰动打乱图像时间特征的先后顺序，在保留图像正常分享的同时主动阻止未经授权的图像到视频动画生成。
en_tdlr: PhaseBreak introduces a white-box spectral retiming protection method based on the key insight that generated dynamics depend on the temporal order of feature events rather than just their strength, applying bounded perturbations that disrupt feature sequencing to proactively prevent unauthorized image-to-video animation while preserving normal image sharing workflows.
